regops.errText: Try again. If it still does not load, give RightOne support the reference below.
regops.music.screens: Screens with sound, such as a television
regops.doc.LEASE: Rental contract or proof of ownership
regops.doc.SUPPLIER_INVOICE: Invoice from the music supplier in use
regops.doc.MUSIC_INVOICE_Q3: Supplier invoice for recorded music, July to September
regops.doc.EQUIPMENT_PHOTO: Photo of the music equipment in use
regops.notInData: The sample data does not hold this part of the record.
regops.why.DRAFT: The application is a draft the premises has not sent. This opens once it is in review.
regops.why.DRAFT_WITHDRAW: The application is a draft. Only the premises can withdraw its own draft.
regops.refusal.APPLICATION_NOT_FOUND.tex: This application does not exist, or it belongs to a premises you may not see. Go back to the list of applications and choose again.
regops.refusal.NOT_AUTHORISED.title: Your role cannot do this
regops.refusal.NOT_AUTHORISED.text: Your role cannot do this. Ask the service owner who holds that authority.
regops.refusal.SEGREGATION_REQUIRED.text: You prepared this proposal, so you cannot approve or return it. It still waits for another approver.
regops.refusal.ASSERTION_NOT_FOUND.title: This claim cannot be shown
regops.refusal.ASSERTION_NOT_FOUND.text: This claim does not exist, or the link to it is out of date. Open the application's case file and choose the claim there, or ask the officer who sent the link.
regops.refusal.PROPOSAL_NOT_FOUND.title: This proposal cannot be shown
regops.refusal.PROPOSAL_NOT_FOUND.text: This decision proposal does not exist, or the link to it is out of date. Ask the officer who sent it for the current link.
regops.refusal.APPLICATION_NOT_UNDER_REV: The application is no longer in review
The application is waiting for documents, decided or ended, so this was not recorded. Reload the case file to see its current status.
regops.refusal.APPLICATION_ALREADY_FINAL: An application that has ended cannot be withdrawn. A refused one is never recorded as withdrawn. If you disagree with the outcome, follow the appeal route in its statement.
regops.refusal.EVIDENCE_REQUEST_OPEN.tit: An evidence request is already open
regops.refusal.EVIDENCE_REQUEST_OPEN.tex: This application already has an open evidence request, so no second one was made. Wait until the applicant sends every item or the request’s due date passes.
regops.refusal.ASSERTION_NOT_UNDER_REVIE: This claim is no longer in review
This claim already has an outcome or was withdrawn with its application, so no outcome was recorded. Reload the case file to see what was recorded.
regops.refusal.PROPOSAL_PENDING.title: A decision proposal is waiting for approval
regops.refusal.PROPOSAL_PENDING.text: A decision proposal on this application is waiting for approval, so another cannot be made. Wait until the approver approves or returns it.
regops.refusal.PROPOSAL_NOT_PENDING.titl: This proposal is no longer waiting
regops.refusal.PROPOSAL_NOT_PENDING.text: This proposal has already been approved, returned or closed by a withdrawal, so no further verdict was recorded. Reload it to see what happened.
regops.refusal.INTENDED_PERIOD_INVALID.t: The decision cannot be issued for this period
The period is not valid, or some of its days are already governed by another decision, including a replaced one for the days before its replacement takes effect. Choose another period.
regops.refusal.PRE_REGISTRATION_OBLIGATI: A charged period cannot start before the registration date. Use before that raises no obligation until a separate decision on it takes effect, and the date the use began is still recorded.
regops.refusal.FACT_NOT_IN_RULEBOOK.titl: The rules do not ask for this
regops.refusal.FACT_NOT_IN_RULEBOOK.text: The registration rules in force do not ask for this item, so it was not saved. Reload the page to see the questions that apply now.
regops.refusal.FACT_VALUE_INVALID.title: The value is not valid
regops.refusal.FACT_VALUE_INVALID.text: This answer is not valid, so it was not saved. Enter it again as the hint under the field shows.
regops.refusal.TARIFF_NOT_APPROVED.title: No approved tariff yet
regops.refusal.TARIFF_NOT_APPROVED.text: No approved tariff applies on this date, so RightOne cannot work out the fee. Your answers are kept, so come back once the tariff is published.
regops.refusal.RULEBOOK_NOT_APPROVED.tex: No version of the registration rules is in force on the day the change takes effect, so the application cannot be sent. The draft is kept to send once a version is approved.
regops.refusal.POLICY_READ_UNAVAILABLE.t: The rules in force could not be read
RightOne could not read the rules in force because of a fault on its side, so nothing was saved. Try again.
regops.refusal.EVIDENCE_ITEMS_EMPTY.text: Nothing was sent to the applicant. Add at least one item, each with a code and a description.
regops.refusal.STATEMENT_INCOMPLETE.text: The proposal was not recorded. A refusal or a decision otherwise than applied for needs its reason, the condition not met and what the applicant can do.
regops.refusal.VERDICT_NOTE_REQUIRED.tit: A note is needed to return
regops.refusal.VERDICT_NOTE_REQUIRED.tex: Write what needs changing so the officer can prepare a new proposal, then return it.
regops.refusal.OUTCOME_REASON_REQUIRED.t: The outcome was not recorded because it has no reason. Choose or enter one.
regops.refusal.ACCEPTED_SCOPE_INVALID.ti: The accepted scope is not valid
regops.refusal.ACCEPTED_SCOPE_INVALID.te: The outcome was not recorded. For a partly accepted outcome, give the accepted part as dates within the claim’s period.
regops.refusal.WITHDRAWAL_INSTRUCTION_RE: An officer may withdraw an application only on the applicant’s recorded instruction. Enter the reference of that letter, message or call record.
regops.refusal.CURSOR_INVALID.title: This list position is not valid
regops.refusal.CURSOR_INVALID.text: A filter or the number of rows per page is not valid. Reload the list from the first page.
regops.refusal.REPORT_PERIOD_INVALID.tex: Choose a start and an end date, the end not before the start, covering at most 366 days.
regops.refusal.AS_OF_REQUIRED.title: A date and time is needed
regops.refusal.AS_OF_REQUIRED.text: Choose the date and time to read the policy at.
Choose why the decision is being changed. For a change after an appeal, also give the appeal case reference.
regops.refusal.APPEAL_CASE_NOT_FOUND.tex: No appeal case with this reference was found, or it has no outcome yet, so no amendment was started. Check the case reference.
regops.refusal.PRIOR_DECISION_SUPERSEDED: This decision has been replaced by a later one, so it cannot be changed. Open the case file of the decision now in force and start the amendment there.
The decision to change was not found
This decision was not found, so no amendment was started. Open the case file again from the queue.
regops.refusal.OPEN_APPLICATION_EXISTS.t: An amendment is already in progress
This premises already has an application of this kind in progress, so no second one was started. Open that application to continue. Its reference is shown with this message.
This application has already been sent, so it cannot be sent again. The case file shows where it stands.
regops.refusal.ATTESTATION_REQUIRED.titl: The premises has not confirmed the current answers
regops.refusal.ATTESTATION_REQUIRED.text: The application has no confirmation from the premises for its current answers, so it was not sent. The premises reviews it and confirms before it is sent.
regops.refusal.REQUIRED_ITEMS_MISSING.te: The application still needs answers the premises gives, so it cannot be sent yet. The premises adds them on the portal, and what it has given is kept.

reg10.amend.caseRefHelp: The appeal case about this decision, which has an outcome.
reg10.amend.fromHelp: Before {d}, the day the decision in force ends. The amendment runs to that day.
reg10.amend.fromInvalid: The date must be before {d}, the day the decision in force ends.
reg10.amend.startWhy: Choose the cause and enter the date it takes effect. For an appeal outcome, also enter the case reference.
reg10.amend.dlgTitle: Start a change of {d} for {p}, because of {c}?
reg10.amend.dlgText: You send it from this case file. The decision in force stays until the new one takes effect.

reg10.sendDlgText: It is decided as an amendment, and the premises is told.
reg10.noticeNotSentText: The evidence request notice has not reached the premises, so the request does not lapse until it is sent.
